pretreatments.description: Ethanolic organosolv pretreatment at 120 °C for 60 min using 50% or 75% ethanol solution in the presence or absence of 1% H2SO4 catalyst.
Ethanolic organosolv pretreatment at 140 °C for 60 min using 50% or 75% ethanol solution in the presence or absence of 1% H2SO4 catalyst.
Ethanolic organosolv pretreatment at 180 °C for 60 min using 50% or 75% ethanol solution in the presence or absence of 1% H2SO4 catalyst.
Enzymatic hydrolysis using Cellic® CTec2 and Cellic® HTec2 enzyme mixture (1:9 ratio) at 45 ± 1 °C and 120 rpm for 72 h.
Anaerobic digestion of the residual solids and the supernatant obtained after pretreatment and enzymatic hydrolysis.
